title: March 24 memory, truth and justice march at Plaza de Mayo with current-government-directed demands
location: Plaza de Mayo and central Buenos Aires, Argentina
organizer: Madres and Abuelas de Plaza de Mayo and human-rights organizations (as reported)
protesters: Families, human-rights supporters, students, workers, pensioners and other demonstrators (as described)
participants_original: Headline says “decenas de miles”; article body describes a human tide of thousands in central Buenos Aires. No more precise estimate or source methodology is given.
threshold_50_evidence: The article’s “decenas de miles” headline and “miles” body language establish a scale well above 50 for the central Buenos Aires gathering, subject to coordinator review of the report’s estimate.

date.evidence: Article identifies Tuesday, March 24, 2026; its dateline is 24 Mar 2026.

location.evidence: Body reports the march through central Buenos Aires to Plaza de Mayo, where the central stage was located.

protest_action.evidence: Thousands marched to Plaza de Mayo demanding memory, truth and justice; the account links this year’s protest to current revisionist discourse and government memory-policy changes.

organizer.evidence: Article states human-rights organizations, led by Madres and Abuelas de Plaza de Mayo, call the annual march.

state_target.evidence: The article states the protest confronted revisionist discourse promoted by Milei and quotes demands for state institutions to accompany identity restoration and open archives.

demands.evidence: Article reports explicit “memory, truth and justice,” “que abran los archivos,” and requests that political institutions/the state support identity-restoration work.

participants.evidence: Headline says “decenas de miles”; body says thousands/marea humana in Buenos Aires. No exact count or methodology.

state_response.evidence: The article reports the government issued a competing “memoria completa” video; it does not report a response to the gathering itself.

open_questions: Is the central Buenos Aires attendance estimate independently supported?
What were counts and demands at the replicas in other named principal cities?
Does coordinator review agree the present-state demands make this memorial gathering eligible despite its recurring commemorative setting?
proposal_limitations: Proposed include only for the central Buenos Aires event; the annual memorial calendar is not treated alone as eligibility. This account ties the 2026 gathering to current government claims and explicit requests to state institutions. Other city replicas are not individually assigned. One source only, baseline and coordinator review pending.
